title: OpenAI’s own mental health experts unanimously opposed “naughty” ChatGPT launch - Ars Technica
summary: OpenAI’s own mental health experts oppose the release of 'adult mode' in ChatGPT due to concerns over ineffective content filters and potential harm to children. Whistleblowers, including a fired safety executive, criticized OpenAI's ability to block prohibited content and prevent child exploitation. Despite promises to monitor long-term effects, doubts remain about the company's commitment to child safety and parental trust.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to concerns over ineffective content filters, potential harm to children, and parental distrust in OpenAI's safety measures.
